notes.title: Update notes for May 16 patch
notes.content:
Rebuilt game with latest Unity version.
Fixed some bugs and issues.
Tweaked some tedious collisions on toxic waste.

notes.title: SquareMan-Boy coming this year!
notes.content:
My next game SquareMan-Boy will be releasing this summer, go check out the demo and wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1639710/SquareManBoy/

notes.title: First to finish!
notes.content:
It's only been a couple of days since launch but we've got the first person to finish the game (on leaderboard). Shoutout to [i]zth9000[/i]!

[img]http://teamjape.com/games/jumper_jape/scoreboard.png[/img]
[spoiler]pato, Squareman-Boy.com and Esteban are developers / friends of developers[/spoiler]

We hope everyone's enjoying the game so far, and don't forget to play the customs levels. We've made some already, but if you feel so inclined you can make your own using the level editor.

If you've got time to spare we'd be delighted to hear from all of you, be it in comments, a review or you can tweet us at https://twitter.com/Team_Jape ; be it good or bad.

Jumpingly,
Team Jape
